name: Reod Dai
description: A man to whom the dwarves sell dragon eggs.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai kills one of the Ironclaw Orcs.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai killed one of them.

citation.text: "Orgg", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai convinces thrulls to turn on their masters; they annihilate the Order and wipe out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia except the thallids; Jherana Rure is killed by thrull assassins.
timeline.quote: annihilating the Order and, save for the thallids , eventually wiping out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia.

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod arranges a trade deal between the Ebon Hand and Havenwood that creates thallids, and is hired by the Elder Druids to distract Icatia.
timeline.quote: creating the thallids , a plentiful, if somewhat bland, food source

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod forms a truce between goblins and orcs of the Crimson Peaks to harass Icatia, but the elves cut the contract.
timeline.quote: However, the contract was cut abruptly, leaving Reod without funds and a hazardous situation on his hands.

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod's dispute with Melelki over dragon eggs destroys the dwarves' house; his seduction spell on Tamun backfires and they fall in love.
timeline.quote: the dwarf's heat caused the spell to backfire, and both fell in love

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod's attempt to blow up the thallid farm fails and instills limited intelligence in the thallids; Sekena leaves with two whelps.
timeline.quote: instilling a limited form of intelligence in the thallids

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod is captured by the elves and imprisoned, then escapes with Andli's help and blows up buried eggs, causing a great fire in the stronghold.
timeline.quote: causing a great fire in the stronghold

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod meets Eliza, is abducted to Achtep Keep, betrays Genkr Nik by starting a thrull rebellion, and is saved by Eliza.
timeline.quote: Reod betrays the deal by starting a rebellion among the Hand's thrulls

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod reaches besieged Gurn Keep and is imprisoned by suspicious dwarves; without his direction the keep falls to the goblins.
timeline.quote: the keep is invaded by the goblins

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod finds Melelki and Tamun and Sekena's dragon carries them away; Tamun still wants to marry him.
timeline.quote: she still wanted to marry him

citation.text: "Reod Dai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Melelki and her daughters find dragon eggs and sell them to Reod Dai.
timeline.quote: find a bunch of dragon eggs and start selling them to a man called Reod Dai .

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "The Going Price , by Sonia Orin Lyris". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai meets an elf emissary in the Crimson Peaks and learns his contract has been cut abruptly.
timeline.quote: However, the contract is cut abruptly.

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "In the Crimson Peaks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A dragon hatches prematurely and attacks the dwarves' hut; Reod saves them by making the whelp explode.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai can save them by causing the dragon whelp to explode

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "In the Crimson Peaks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod's seduction spell backfires, causing him and Tamun to fall in love.
timeline.quote: causing the two to fall in love

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "In the Crimson Peaks". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the road the group passes Kalitas, destroyed by the orc-goblin army, and learns it marches on Teedmar.
timeline.quote: they pass by Kalitas, a dwarven town that has been destroyed by the orc-goblin army

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "To Havenwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tamun and Reod are forced to kill an Icatian patrol, and Reod's past as the Icatian soldier Robin Davis is revealed.
timeline.quote: Reod was an Icatian soldier, born Robin Davis

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "To Havenwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Havenwood Reod tries to blow up the elves' thallid farm, but it is protected from magic and two eggs hatch without exploding.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai tries to blow up the Thallid farm of the elves

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "To Havenwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod, Melelki and Tamun bury eggs around the elves' fortress and are captured.
timeline.quote: before being spotted and captured by the elves

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "To Havenwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod escapes prison with the help of an elven child, blowing up the buried eggs and causing a great fire.
timeline.quote: not before blowing up the buried eggs, causing a great fire

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "To Havenwood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Teedmar Reod and Eliza are ambushed by an Ebon Hand wizard, who reveals thallids have gained sentience and the Hand caused the volcano to erupt.
timeline.quote: they had caused the volcano near Teedmar to erupt, to kill the dwarves for selling weapons to Icatia

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Teedmar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The volcano buries Teedmar under lava while the wizard teleports Reod and Eliza to Achtep Keep.
timeline.quote: they find the city buried under the lava

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Teedmar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod and Eliza are locked up by the Thrulls, and Reod incites them to rebel.
timeline.quote: he and Eliza are locked up in a cell by the Thrulls

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Achtep Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eliza rescues Reod from torture, the thrulls kill the Ebon Hand, and Reod promises to aid their revolt.
timeline.quote: The thrulls kill the members of the Ebon Hand

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Achtep Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod reaches Gurn Keep and agrees to help the dwarves resist, but is jailed as a suspected spy and the keep is invaded.
timeline.quote: Reod agrees to help the dwarves with their resistance

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Gurn Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sekena flies her dragon to the keep and carries Reod, Melelki and Tamun away; Tamun says she still wants to marry him.
timeline.quote: she still wants to marry him

citation.text: "And Peace Shall Sleep", section "At Gurn Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 170 AR an agent of Genkr Nik captures Reod Dai and brings him to Achtep Keep.
timeline.quote: an agent of Genkr Nik captured Reod Dai and brought him to Achtep Keep

citation.text: "Achtep Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod plans a thrull rebellion; some thrulls betray him and Genkr tortures him.
timeline.quote: Reod then hatched a plan to start a thrull rebellion.

citation.text: "Achtep Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The rebellion starts and Eliza frees Reod, taking him to the Crimson Peaks.
timeline.quote: allowing Eliza to free Reod and bring him to the Crimson Peaks

citation.text: "Achtep Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elves hire Reod Dai to pit orcs and humans against each other; he unites goblin and orc tribes into one horde.
timeline.quote: the elves hired Reod Dai to pit the two against each other

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai's magic gives thallids sentience and he incites the thrull rebellion against the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai then incited a rebellion among the thrulls against their Ebon Hand masters.

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai passes through the goblin army into Gurn Keep and helps organize its defenses before being imprisoned by the distrustful dwarves.
timeline.quote: After the siege had begun, Reod Dai passed through the goblin army and entered the keep, looking for Tamun .

citation.text: "Gurn Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sekena, mounted on her bonded dragon, saves Reod, Tamun and Melelki from the swarming goblins.
timeline.quote: The three of them were saved from the swarming goblins by Tamun's sister Sekena mounted on her bonded dragon .

citation.text: "Gurn Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the fourth year of egg harvesting Reod Dai refuses to pay; an egg hatches in the dwarves' basement and Reod destroys the hatchling and their house with an exploding spell.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai suddenly refused to pay the agreed-upon sum

citation.text: "Sekena", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The dwarves join Reod north to dispose of the eggs; Sekena bonds with the dragons and takes two surviving whelps toward Teedmar.
timeline.quote: She brought two of the surviving whelps with her and headed towards Teedmar

citation.text: "Sekena", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sekena has the dragons fly to besieged Gurn Keep and rescue Tamun, herself and Reod Dai before the keep falls.
timeline.quote: Sekena ordered the dragons to fly to Gurn Keep

citation.text: "Sekena", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod and Tamun pledge themselves to each other and the family resolves to face the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires.
timeline.quote: Reod and Sekena's sister Tamun then pledged themselves to each other

citation.text: "Sekena", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
